mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotation.quotation (id, transport_request_id, quotation_no, transport_request_version_no, status, expires_at, total_amount, currency, route_policy_via, route_policy_departure_at, route_policy_arrival_at, internal_approved_by, internal_approved_at, presented_at, replaced_by_quotation_id, shipper_response, responded_by, responded_at, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{transportRequestId}, #{quotationNo}, #{transportRequestVersionNo}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{totalAmount}, #{currency}, #{routePolicyVia}, #{routePolicyDepartureAt}, #{routePolicyArrivalAt}, #{internalApprovedBy}, #{internalApprovedAt}, #{presentedAt}, #{replacedByQuotationId}, #{shipperResponse}, #{respondedBy}, #{respondedAt}, #{version})

INSERT INTO quotation.pricing_line (quotation_id, line_no, description, amount, currency, contract_reference) VALUES (#{quotationId}, #{lineNo}, #{description}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{contractReference})
mapper.update: UPDATE quotation.quotation SET status = #{row.status}, expires_at = #{row.expiresAt}, total_amount = #{row.totalAmount}, currency = #{row.currency}, route_policy_via = #{row.routePolicyVia}, route_policy_departure_at = #{row.routePolicyDepartureAt}, route_policy_arrival_at = #{row.routePolicyArrivalAt}, internal_approved_by = #{row.internalApprovedBy}, internal_approved_at = #{row.internalApprovedAt}, presented_at = #{row.presentedAt}, replaced_by_quotation_id = #{row.replacedByQuotationId}, shipper_response = #{row.shipperResponse}, responded_by = #{row.respondedBy}, responded_at = #{row.respondedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{row.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, transport_request_id, quotation_no, transport_request_version_no, status, expires_at, total_amount, currency, route_policy_via, route_policy_departure_at, route_policy_arrival_at, internal_approved_by, internal_approved_at, presented_at, replaced_by_quotation_id, shipper_response, responded_by, responded_at, version FROM quotation.quotation WHERE transport_request_id = #{transportRequestId} ORDER BY quotation_no

SELECT r.request_number, q.quotation_no, q.status, q.expires_at FROM quotation.transport_request r JOIN quotation.quotation q ON q.transport_request_id = r.id WHERE r.status = 'QUOTED' AND q.quotation_no = (SELECT MAX(latest.quotation_no) FROM quotation.quotation latest WHERE latest.transport_request_id = r.id) ORDER BY q.expires_at, r.request_number

SELECT r.request_number, q.quotation_no, q.responded_at, q.expires_at FROM quotation.transport_request r JOIN quotation.quotation q ON q.transport_request_id = r.id WHERE r.status = 'ROUTING' AND q.status = 'ROUTING_REQUESTED' ORDER BY q.responded_at, r.request_number

SELECT l.quotation_id, l.line_no, l.description, l.amount, l.currency, l.contract_reference FROM quotation.pricing_line l JOIN quotation.quotation q ON q.id = l.quotation_id WHERE q.transport_request_id = #{transportRequestId} ORDER BY l.quotation_id, l.line_no
